narrative.details: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Mm, yum! This pie is the best!

I think my memory is coming back to me...
narrative.requestItemsText: Ugh... I'm starving! Do you have that pie for me, adventurer?
